# InfoQ

> InfoQ is a leading source for software development news, trends, and best practices, featuring curated content on architecture, DevOps, cloud infrastructure, and emerging technologies.

InfoQ aggregates and publishes high-quality content including news, in-depth articles, conference presentations, podcasts, and guides covering the full spectrum of modern software development. The platform serves a global audience with localized editions in multiple languages and offers opportunities for industry professionals to contribute their expertise.

## Key Topics

- software-architecture
- DevOps
- cloud-infrastructure
- Java ecosystem
- AI coding
- API design
- software-development
- .NET
- Kafka

- QCon conferences

## Core Content Hubs

- [News Feed](https://www.infoq.com/news): Latest news covering tools, libraries, and announcements from major tech companies
- [Articles](https://www.infoq.com/articles): Feature-length articles exploring emerging software development trends and best practices
- [Development](https://www.infoq.com/development): Development news covering DevOps, cloud, AI coding, and API design
- [Presentations](https://www.infoq.com/presentations): Conference presentations from QCon and other InfoQ events
- [Podcasts](https://www.infoq.com/podcasts): 30-minute podcast interviews with software architects and industry leaders
- [Guides & eMags](https://www.infoq.com/minibooks): In-depth guides and eMags covering AI, architecture, and development trends

## Programming Languages & Ecosystems

- [Java](https://www.infoq.com/java): Java ecosystem news: Java 9+, Spring, Kotlin, JVM updates, and related technologies
- [.NET](https://www.infoq.com/dotnet): .NET ecosystem news: C#, .NET Core, Blazor, and related development tools
- [C#](https://www.infoq.com/c_sharp): C# programming language updates and .NET development news
- [Kotlin](https://www.infoq.com/kotlin): Kotlin programming language basics and real-world applications

## Community & Newsletters

- [Software Architects Newsletter](https://www.infoq.com/software-architects-newsletter): Curated newsletter for software architects, edited by Daniel Bryant and Thomas Betts
- [Write for InfoQ](https://www.infoq.com/write-for-infoq): Contributor program offering writing and speaking opportunities at InfoQ

## Global Editions

- [InfoQ Japan](https://www.infoq.com/jp): InfoQ Japan: software development news and trends in Japanese
- [InfoQ France](https://www.infoq.com/fr): InfoQ France: software development news and trends in French
